On Mon, Sep 28, 2026 at 8:14 AM Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com> wrote:
> Luke / Marketplace team —
> 
> Quick kickoff on the AWS listing items we discussed in last week's co-sell call. Goal: lock hero microcopy + short IAM guidance snippet and confirm SKU/pricing mapping so Acme can start the onboarding checklist.

We plan to go subscription (annual) for our enterprise deal, but we may want a metered option for smaller customers later. For this listing we need the SKU rows to include: SKU name, unit (per-seat vs per-month), price band, and whether it's eligible for co-sell credits. Your sheet looks good — I'll confirm the final prices by EOD.

On IAM copy: keep it minimal. Something like:
"Redwood runs in your VPC using IAM roles for cross-account access. See our docs for a step-by-step role setup and least-privilege template."

That fits the product page limit — we can shorten further if Marketplace requires < 200 chars.

Also: can you confirm whether the hero image should show "Hosted API + Dedicated" or just "Hosted API"? We prefer the former but Acme legal asked to avoid implying Dedicated is included unless on the purchase order.

Luke
